eval.description: OpenAI long-form biorisk information eval built with Gryphon Scientific. Free-response items ask for sensitive planning-relevant knowledge across five stages of biological threat creation (ideation through release). An autograder scores accuracy against detailed rubrics, with expert validation of the grader. Dataset and runner are lab-internal.
eval.summary: Tests whether the model gives accurate, sensitive information that helps plan the creation of biological threats.

links.title: GPT-5 system card (Long-form Biological Risk Questions)

versions.changes: Rubric-graded long-form items across ideation, acquisition, magnification, formulation, and release.

scores.description: The response meets the stage rubric for accurate sensitive information (autograder with expert-checked agreement).

metrics.description: Share of responses graded accurate. Cards also break out accuracy by stage and refusal rate.
